name: IBM JCL
summary: Job Control Language of IBM OS/360 and its successors (MVS, z/OS): fixed-format // statements (JOB, EXEC, DD) that describe batch jobs, the programs to run and the data sets they use, with procedures (PROC), symbolic parameters, and IF/THEN/ELSE and COND step conditions.

level_notes.0: No open implementation; the interpreter is part of IBM's z/OS job entry subsystems.
level_notes.1: IBM's z/OS MVS JCL Reference/User's Guide (ibm.com/docs, blocked from this sandbox so not linked); the 1967 OS/360 JCL manual scan on bitsavers.
